The company demonstrates strong profitability with a 65% gross margin and 23% operating margin, supporting its ability to service its debt. However, its highly leveraged balance sheet (total liabilities of $84.8 billion) and low current ratio (0.53) suggest significant capital intensity and reliance on debt refinancing, typical of the telecommunications or utility sectors. These factors support an investment-grade rating with some leverage-related constraints.

DECISION: BBB+
